question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Build: for each league, find all teams and their win counts, then pick the one with fewest wins
WITH team_league AS (
    -- Get all teams that appear in each league (both home and away)
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id as league_id, l.name as league_name, t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id as league_id, l.name as league_name, t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        tl.league_id,
        tl.league_name,
        tl.team_long_name,
        tl.team_api_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = tl.team_api_id THEN 1 END)
        + COUNT(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = tl.team_api_id THEN 1 END) as total_wins
    FROM team_league tl
    LEFT JOIN Match m ON (m.league_id = tl.league_id AND (m.home_team_api_id = tl.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = tl.team_api_id))
    GROUP BY tl.league_id, tl.league_name, tl.team_long_name, tl.team_api_id
)
SELECT league_name, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM win_counts
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY league_name

WITH team_league AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT l.id as league_id, l.name as league_name, t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id
    FROM Match m

),

    SELECT 
        tl.league_id,
        tl.league_name,
        tl.team_long_name,

    GROUP BY tl.league_id, tl.league_name, tl.team_long_name, tl.team_api_id
)
